implementation.format: Adaptive bottom banner separated from task controls
implementation.localData: Rooms; task title/duration/repeat interval/priority/last completion date; pending session; explicit completion journal. Private atomic app file. Deleting task retains past history snapshots. Clearing app storage removes all records/preferences.
implementation.retryPolicy: One banner request at a time;45s watchdog; three delayed retries10/30/60s; fresh budget on foreground/network restoration

appAccess.instructions: Select Contextual ads at first launch. Choose starter tasks or Start empty. The 5/15/30 minute buttons preview due tasks and explanations; Start session persists it. Mark actual completions individually. My tasks manages tasks; Rooms manages rooms; History shows explicit completions. Core features work offline.

advertisingId.basis: The exact SDK8.5.0 includes AdvertisingIdClient and direct service fallback API paths. Removing AD_ID is distinct from SDK API usage and residual technical identifiers. Nonzero Google Advertising ID is not claimed for target36 with permission removed.

dataSafety.approximateLocationBasis: Conservative disclosure for Yandex IP-inferred region during ad requests in either mode. Device GPS is not requested or used.
dataSafety.deviceIdsBasis: Conservative disclosure of technical advertising identifiers remaining in ad requests. No app control stops all ad requests; consent changes personalization. AD_ID removal does not justify a blanket no-identifiers claim.
dataSafety.notes: Declarations must be saved in the actual Play form against the verified final merged manifest/dependencies. This prepared JSON is not a Console receipt or submitted questionnaire.

App interactions.basis: Conservative disclosure of installation/session and app-open statistics; no raw record content or custom actions.

Other app performance data.basis: Technical device/OS/app information sent by the SDK; crash and ANR reports disabled.

Device or other IDs.basis: Technical analytics identifier; advertising identifier collection disabled in AppMetrica.

dataSafety.appMetricaNotes: Prepared source-backed disclosure, not a submitted Play Console answer. AppMetrica analytics are required in this implementation because there is no analytics opt-out; the advertising personalization choice does not stop these statistics. Verify final release and update the actual Play form before publishing the release.
